fullTextZH: 你小的时候有喜欢的人吗？
fullTextEN: Did you have someone you liked when you were little?

fullTextZH: 我7岁的时候就有喜欢的人。
fullTextEN: I had someone I liked when I was 7 years old.

fullTextZH: 因为他给我用他的铅笔，
fullTextEN: Because he let me use his pencil,
and let me play with his toys.

fullTextZH: 我每天去学校都很开心。
fullTextEN: I was very happy to go to school every day.

fullTextZH: 我的妈妈带我去看医生。
fullTextEN: My mom took me to see the doctor.
The doctor said I needed glasses,

fullTextZH: 你就看不清楚太远的东西。
fullTextEN: you can't see things far away clearly.

fullTextZH: 你要戴眼镜才看得清楚。
fullTextEN: You need to wear glasses to see clearly.

fullTextZH: 所以我的妈妈带我去买眼镜。
fullTextEN: So my mom took me to buy glasses.

fullTextZH: 妈妈说：“上课的时候戴眼镜才看得清楚老师写的字。”
fullTextEN: Mom said, "You need to wear glasses in class to see the words the teacher writes clearly."

fullTextZH: 黑板上的字变得好清楚哦！
fullTextEN: The words on the blackboard became so clear!
But the boy next to me,

fullTextZH: 我觉得你戴眼镜好丑哦。”
fullTextEN: I think you look ugly with glasses."

fullTextZH: 我听到的时候觉得心都碎了。
fullTextEN: When I heard that, I felt heartbroken.

fullTextZH: 我喜欢的人说我很丑啊。
fullTextEN: The person I like said I'm ugly.
The person you like says you're ugly,
Then I just won't wear them.

fullTextZH: 回家的时候，我把眼镜收起来。
fullTextEN: When going home, I put away my glasses.

fullTextZH: 去学校的时候，我也不戴。
fullTextEN: When going to school, I also don't wear them.

fullTextZH: 有一天，我在学校的时候，
fullTextEN: One day, when I was at school,

fullTextZH: 我看到我的妈妈在教室门口。
fullTextEN: I saw my mom at the classroom door.

fullTextZH: 我不知道为什么我的妈妈在教室门口。
fullTextEN: I didn't know why my mom was at the classroom door.

fullTextZH: 因为我的妈妈发现我的眼镜在家里，
fullTextEN: Because my mom found my glasses at home,

fullTextZH: 我不能跟妈妈说为什么我不想戴眼镜。
fullTextEN: I couldn't tell my mom why I didn't want to wear glasses.
I think I was really silly.

fullTextZH: 那个时候，老师写的字我都看不清楚，
fullTextEN: At that time, I couldn't clearly see the words the teacher wrote,
I had to squint to see,

fullTextZH: 你为了喜欢的人做过什么奇怪的事吗？
fullTextEN: Have you ever done anything strange for someone you like?
Please leave a message and share with me.
